basic_info.description: Panoramic views from Coit Tower to the Bay Bridge can be seen from this luxury doorman building. Sitting on top of Nob Hill, this corner unit has been remodeled and meticulously maintained. Expansive windows offer ample natural light and showcase the stunning views of Telegraph Hill, Coit Tower, the Transamerica Building, glimpses of the bay bridge and full downtown and bay views. A formal entry opens into the updated galley kitchen, designed to be a chef's delight with stainless steel appliances. The seamless transition connects the open living and dining room which steps out to a private balcony. Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout. The spacious bedrooms offer a serene retreat with bathrooms that have been updated with luxury tile surrounds. 1 car parking with EV charger, doorman, elevator, laundry room, secure entry. Close proximity to restaurants, cafes, luxury hotels, FiDi, Hunting Park, Chinatown, North Beach, Union Square, public transportation and the cable car.
